messages:
Sam: Heads-up — we have a subtle ordering risk for tonight's flip. API change (v2 routing header) goes live at 22:00 UTC but runtime kernel switch and router header split are staggered.
Tara: can you summarise the dependency order you want? is this a hard block or a mitigation request?
Sam: Hard block unless we sequence: 1) router header split 2) runtime kernel flag 3) API rollout. Console needs a read-only schema update in between to avoid 500s on admin pages.
Ryan: +1 on ordering. Also need to pin the API -> runtime compatibility matrix to the deploy ticket. If runtime is older, traffic should hedge to v1 for 90s.
Sam: @deploy-bot can we enforce an ephemeral traffic cut to 0% for 60s between steps if health degrades?
deploy-bot: redeploy-plan created: job/flip-1825. Stages: router-split -> runtime-quant-switch -> api-release. Canary window 5m. Automated rollback threshold: 5xx rate > 1% over 60s or p95 latency regress +200ms.
Tara: That rollback rule seems aggressive for user-facing latency. Can we tighten to 2% and add manual hold for Console schema migrations? Console team wants a manual ack.
Ryan: Agreed on manual hold for console. Also add a version-pin header so runtime can treat requests from api:v2 as experimental.
Sam: Proposed playbook snippet: ```
# manual steps
1) run `./ops/check-compat --service=router --schema=hdr-v2`
2) flip router-split (deploy-bot)
3) wait 30s smoke, if errors run `./ops/rollback router-split`
4) flip runtime kernel (canary 10%), monitor kv-eviction, p95
5) pin API to runtime vX in rollout config, then release api
``` 
Tara: This looks good. One more: add an ops-bot quick-check to validate KV cache warming after runtime flip.
ops-bot: scheduled check `kv-warm-1825` will run at stage boundary and post results to thread.
Ryan: Who will own the manual Console ack? @Tara or @Sam?
Tara: I'll own it and will post `Console ACK` once read-only schema finishes migrating (should be <3m).
Sam: OK final decision: require Console ACK, ops-bot pass, and deploy-bot will enforce 2% 5xx rollback threshold. If any stage fails, immediate rollback to previous router and runtime flags. Documenting in release notes.
Tara: adding a short release note blurb: "Sequenced rollout: router header split -> runtime kernel -> API v2. Manual console ack required. Rollback criteria: 5xx >2% over 60s or p95 regress >200ms."
Ryan: I'll attach the compatibility matrix to the ticket and pin versions.
Sam: Thanks — I'll start the dry-run at 21:15 UTC and will ping here before the live window.
Tara: :thumbsup:
Sam: deploybot, please mark the ticket with `manual-console-ack` label.
deploy-bot: label `manual-console-ack` added to job/flip-1825. Good luck :rocket:
